scope: Owned development DB and separate fictional quarantine media/state volumes; no permanent purge or live integration

tests.name: Explicit review acknowledgement is mandatory
Stale reviewed revision cannot mutate media
Invalid fictional actor/evidence is rejected
Traversal cannot address storage outside the owned root
Generated-looking unregistered files are never adopted
Reviewed orphan is copied, verified and withdrawn into quarantine
Private archive retains exact registered content
Public quota is released while private quarantine usage remains counted
An identical reordered case is an idempotent replay
Conflicting reuse of a case is rejected
Cooperative reference writers reject quarantined assets
Browser reference writes are rejected before catalogue/upload mutation
Private quarantine object names are not served by the public app
Restore cannot overwrite a colliding public file
Changed quarantine content is held rather than restored
Restore republishes verified bytes without losing the rescue archive
Restored files receive a fresh cleanup grace period
Audit contains reviewed actors, cases and strictly increasing sequences
Permanent purge is not an exposed action
Young assets remain in place
A reference added after review is rechecked at execution
Content drift after review cannot be quarantined
Quarantine file quota is enforced without removing the source
Quarantine byte quota is enforced independently
Concurrent identical cleanup creates one move and one replay
Different reviewed cases cannot both withdraw the same asset
A reference writer already holding the gate wins before cleanup
Reference creation waits for cleanup then rejects the withdrawn asset
Interruption at prepared retains at least one verified copy
Pending prepared pauses new upload admission
Reviewed recovery finishes prepared idempotently and safely
Completed recovery replays without adding audit or moving data
Interruption at copied retains at least one verified copy
Pending copied pauses new upload admission
Reviewed recovery finishes copied idempotently and safely
Interruption at source_removed retains at least one verified copy
Pending source_removed pauses new upload admission
Reviewed recovery finishes source_removed idempotently and safely
Recovery rechecks references added through a trusted bypass
Reviewed rollback preserves newly referenced public data
Rollback can restore a source already removed after verified copy
Interrupted restore at prepared preserves the archive
Restore recovery finishes prepared without overwriting data
Interrupted restore at published preserves the archive
Restore recovery finishes published without overwriting data
Interrupted restore at restore_published preserves the archive
Restore recovery finishes restore_published without overwriting data
Reviewed rollback of an unpublished restore keeps the private copy
Restore respects active quota and keeps its private rescue copy
Restore and upload cannot oversubscribe the last public slot
Owned quarantine fixture stopped; media and audit volumes retained
